attorneys: Vivian Wyclijj Buie, pro se. Solicitor General Fahy for the United States.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to proceed in jorma pauperis is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit is denied for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law. Rule XI of the Criminal Appeals Rules, 292 U. S. 665-66; United States ex rel. Coy v. United States, 316 U. S. 342.
